```{r}
# Read the dense matrix
dt <- fread("GSM3516662_MSK_LX653_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz")
dt <- as.data.frame(dt)   

# transposing matrix and formatting row names
dt <- t(dt)
rownames(dt) <- make.unique(rownames(dt))

# creating Seurat object
# need to decide on filtering parameters... look back at old work
## min.cells will filter genes in less than x cells and min.features will filter cells with less than y genes expressed
object <- CreateSeuratObject(dt, project = "thesis", assay = "RNA", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, names.field = 1,
  names.delim = "_", meta.data = NULL)

object
```

```{r}
# list of my files
List_of_files =  c("GSM3516662_MSK_LX653_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516663_MSK_LX661_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516664_MSK_LX666_METASTASIS_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516665_MSK_LX675_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516666_MSK_LX675_NORMAL_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516667_MSK_LX676_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516668_MSK_LX255B_METASTASIS_dense.csv.gz",  "GSM3516669_MSK_LX679_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516670_MSK_LX680_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516671_MSK_LX681_METASTASIS_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516672_MSK_LX682_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516673_MSK_LX682_NORMAL_dense.csv.gz",   "GSM3516674_MSK_LX684_PRIMARY_TUMOUR_dense.csv.gz",  "GSM3516675_MSK_LX684_NORMAL_dense.csv.gz",   "GSM3516676_MSK_LX685_NORMAL_dense.csv.gz", "GSM3516677_MSK_LX699_METASTASIS_dense.csv.gz",   "GSM3516678_MSK_LX701_METASTASIS_dense.csv.gz" )

for (x in 1: length(List_of_files)){
  currData <- List_of_files[x]
  # Read the dense matrix
  dt <- fread(currData)
  dt <- as.data.frame(dt) 
  # transposing matrix and formatting row names
  dt <- t(dt)
  rownames(dt) <- make.unique(rownames(dt))
  CreateSeuratObject(dt, project = "thesis", assay = "RNA", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200, names.field = 1,
  names.delim = "_", meta.data = NULL)
}


```
